items.summary: Reliance Industries shares surged on Monday, marking their sharpest single-day rally in nearly seven years and adding Rs 1 lakh crore to its market capitalisation, taking it to Rs 17 lakh crore. The rally followed strong Q2 FY27 results, with consolidated net profit rising 41% year-on-year to Rs 25,548 crore and revenue growing 29% to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. The oil-to-chemicals segment led earnings growth, with EBITDA jumping 68% to a record Rs 25,203 crore.
